name: Beau Thompson
bio: Beau Thompson is known for The Death of Robin Hood (2026), Blood on Snow (2026) and Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint.

credits.title: Merry Christmas Aubrey Flint
credits.overview: An amateur production of A Christmas Carol at a retirement home is reluctantly directed by reclusive man on community service.

credits.title: The Death of Robin Hood
credits.overview: Grappling with his past after a life of crime and murder, Robin Hood finds himself gravely injured after a battle he thought would be his last. In the hands of a mysterious woman, he is offered a chance at salvation.

credits.title: Making of Lord of the Flies
credits.overview: A trippy tale capturing the creative vision of writer Jack Thorne and director Marc Munden, as a British crew and young cast film this timely adaptation on the remote islands of Malaysia during monsoon season.
